title.zh: Strategy斥资9.508亿美元回购STRC，远超同期比特币买入
title.en: Strategy prioritizes $950 million STRC buyback over expanding its Bitcoin treasury

current_state.zh: Strategy继续将资本配置优先用于STRC回购以维持其接近100美元的目标价：截至2026年10月11日，USD Cash降至6.405亿美元（8月30日为16.1亿美元），20亿美元STRC回购授权仅剩3.548亿美元，USD Reserve降至48.8亿美元。比特币持仓为848,000枚（截至10月5日）。股东10月28日将就优先股每日派息投票。按近期消耗速度，USD Cash若不补充或在约四周内耗尽。
current_state.en: Strategy continues prioritizing STRC buybacks to defend its ~$100 target price: as of Oct 11, 2026, USD Cash fell to $640.5M (from $1.61B on Aug 30), only $354.8M of its $2B STRC buyback authorization remained, and the USD Reserve declined to $4.88B. BTC holdings were 848,000 as of Oct 5. Shareholders vote Oct 28 on daily preferred dividends. At the recent burn rate, USD Cash could be depleted in about four weeks without replenishment.

updates.title_zh: Strategy斥资9.508亿美元回购STRC，远超同期比特币买入
updates.title_en: Strategy prioritizes $950 million STRC buyback over expanding its Bitcoin treasury
updates.what_changed_zh:
Strategy在7月20日至9月13日的八个报告期内，累计回购约996万股STRC可变利率优先股，耗资约9.508亿美元；其中9月14日文件披露，公司在9月8日至13日回购了1,420,467股STRC，金额1.393亿美元。同一时段内，其唯一披露的比特币买入是8月24日至30日购得的4,603枚BTC、耗资3.697亿美元，即STRC回购支出约为同期比特币买入的2.57倍。

Strategy是持有比特币最多的上市公司，其把可自由支配的现金用于回购自家优先股而非继续增持比特币，是一个重要的资本配置信号，直接影响市场对企业级比特币金库需求增长节奏的判断。这也把投资者注意力引向支撑其比特币持仓的融资结构——优先股股息及其偿付储备，对MSTR股票和STRC优先股持有人都同样重要。

本次回购全部来自Strategy可灵活支配的USD Cash余额，截至9月13日该余额为13亿美元；另有一笔51亿美元的USD Reserve专门用于支付优先股股息和债务利息，且根据7月27日的政策，该储备未被授权用于STRC回购。公司在9月8日至13日报告期内既未买入也未卖出比特币，也未通过at-the-market（ATM）计划出售股份，截至9月13日仍持有845,050枚BTC；董事会已于9月8日将优先证券回购授权额度翻倍至20亿美元，尚余约10亿美元可用。
updates.what_changed_en: Strategy has spent roughly $950.8 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares since July 20, more than twice its Bitcoin purchases over the same period, while keeping about $1 billion authorized for further buybacks.
updates.current_state_zh:
Strategy在7月20日至9月13日的八个报告期内，累计回购约996万股STRC可变利率优先股，耗资约9.508亿美元；其中9月14日文件披露，公司在9月8日至13日回购了1,420,467股STRC，金额1.393亿美元。同一时段内，其唯一披露的比特币买入是8月24日至30日购得的4,603枚BTC、耗资3.697亿美元，即STRC回购支出约为同期比特币买入的2.57倍。

updates.current_state_en: Strategy has spent roughly $950.8 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares since July 20, more than twice its Bitcoin purchases over the same period, while keeping about $1 billion authorized for further buybacks.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Strategy has spent roughly $950.8 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares since July 20, more than twice its Bitcoin purchases over the same period, while keeping about $1 billion authorized for further buybacks.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Strategy has spent roughly $950.8 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares since July 20, more than twice its Bitcoin purchases over the same period, while keeping about $1 billion authorized for further buybacks.
updates.background_zh: Strategy（原MicroStrategy）是全球持有比特币最多的上市公司，历史上主要通过发行股票筹资买入比特币，其中包括以市价分批出售股份的at-the-market（ATM）计划。除普通股外，公司还发行了多个系列的优先股，其中STRC（ marketed 为“Stretch”）是一只永续可变利率优先股，按12%年化利率以现金派息，股息率每月调整，以促使其价格围绕100美元面值交易。7月27日的回购政策指出，以低于100美元面值回购这些股份可以折价降低未来的优先股股息负担，这使公司即使不增持比特币，也有动力回购自家证券。
updates.background_en: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) is the largest corporate holder of Bitcoin and has historically funded purchases by issuing equity, including through at-the-market programs that sell shares incrementally into the market. In addition to common stock, it has issued several series of preferred shares, of which STRC (marketed as "Stretch") is a perpetual variable-rate preferred paying a 12% annual dividend in cash, with the rate reset monthly to encourage trading near its $100 par value. The July 27 buyback policy states that repurchasing these shares below their $100 stated amount can reduce future preferred-dividend requirements at a discount, giving the company a reason to buy its own securities even when the spending does not add Bitcoin to the treasury.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径经由全球最大的企业比特币金库载体：原本可投入现货比特币增持的现金，如今流向优先股回购，从而放缓了一个可辨识的企业级现货需求来源；而在此前阶段，Strategy曾分别卖出1,638枚和1,690枚BTC，用于支付优先股股息和STRC回购，增加了现货供给。回购同时支撑STRC优先股价格向100美元面值靠拢，进而影响MSTR的融资成本和未来继续买入比特币的能力，不过八周的对比尚不足以说明公司战略发生永久性转变。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through the largest corporate Bitcoin treasury vehicle: cash that previously fed spot BTC accumulation is instead going to preferred-share buybacks, slowing one identifiable source of corporate spot demand, while earlier in the campaign Strategy sold 1,638 BTC and 1,690 BTC to fund preferred dividends and STRC repurchases, adding to spot supply. The buybacks also affect the STRC preferred market itself by supporting the price toward its $100 par value, which in turn shapes MSTR's cost of capital and its capacity to fund future Bitcoin purchases, though the eight-week comparison does not establish a permanent change in strategy.

updates.title_zh: Strategy 已用掉其 STRC 救助基金的 64%
updates.title_en: Strategy has burned through 64% of its STRC rescue fund
updates.what_changed_zh: 最新披露显示，Strategy累计回购STRC的支出已增至约12.8亿美元，占20亿美元回购授权额度的64%，剩余不足7.24亿美元；累计回购约1330万股STRC，约占流通股的八分之一。上周回购支出1.517亿美元，回购均价升至98.86美元，远高于7月底约86.52美元的均价。
updates.what_changed_en: Latest disclosure shows Strategy has spent about $1.28 billion, or 64%, of its $2 billion STRC repurchase authorization, leaving less than $724 million; it has repurchased 13.3 million STRC shares, roughly one in eight outstanding. Last week it spent $151.7 million at an average price of $98.86, up from an average of $86.52 in late July.
updates.current_state_zh: Strategy累计动用约12.8亿美元回购STRC，20亿美元授权额度剩余不足7.24亿美元；累计回购约1330万股STRC。STRC最新开盘价约99.18美元，仍低于其宣称的100美元目标价，且大部分交易时间低于该目标。
updates.current_state_en: Strategy has used about $1.28 billion of its $2 billion STRC repurchase authorization, with less than $724 million remaining, and has repurchased about 13.3 million STRC shares. STRC opened at about $99.18, still below its stated $100 target and has traded below that target for most of its history.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Strategy has spent $1.28 billion, or 64%, of its $2 billion STRC repurchase fund, leaving less than $724 million as the preferred stock continues trading well below its $100 target.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Strategy has spent $1.28 billion, or 64%, of its $2 billion STRC repurchase fund, leaving less than $724 million as the preferred stock continues trading well below its $100 target.
updates.background_zh: Saylor 于 2025 年 7 月推出 STRC，作为一种支付可变股息的永续优先股，并以「源自 BTC 的收益、但无 BTC 式波动」作为卖点。由于 BTC 未能达到他所描述的约 30% 年涨幅，董事会将 STRC 股息提高至 12%，并于 6 月 29 日批准 10 亿美元回购资金，随后在 9 月 8 日前将该授权翻倍至 20 亿美元。STRC 股价在 6 月还曾跌破每股 72 美元。
updates.background_en: Saylor introduced STRC in July 2025 as a perpetual preferred stock paying a variable dividend, pitched as yielding income derived from BTC without BTC-style volatility. As BTC lagged the roughly 30% annual pace he had described, the board raised STRC's dividend to 12% and authorized a $1 billion buyback fund on June 29, then doubled that authorization to $2 billion by September 8. STRC traded below $72 per share as recently as June.
updates.market_impact_zh: Strategy 是最大的企业级比特币持有者，其购买 BTC 的能力依赖通过 MSTR 普通股和优先股筹集的资金；回购资金缓冲缩小以及持续的普通股稀释，会影响这一融资渠道的成本与容量。这一传导主要通过 MSTR、STRC 以及更广泛的「比特币储备公司」板块体现，对 BTC 需求端资金流的影响则是间接的。
updates.market_impact_en: Strategy is the largest corporate bitcoin holder, and its BTC purchases depend on capital raised through MSTR common and preferred stock; a shrinking repurchase cushion and continued common-share dilution affect the cost and capacity of that funding channel. That transmission runs primarily through MSTR and STRC as well as the wider bitcoin-treasury-company segment, and only indirectly to BTC demand-side flows.

updates.title_zh: Strategy选择加大STRC回购支出，而非购买BTC
updates.title_en: Strategy opts for bigger spending on STRC buybacks over BTC purchases
updates.what_changed_zh: 2026年9月29日至10月5日当周，Strategy买入334枚BTC（花费2870万美元），同时以1.763亿美元回购约177万股STRC；比特币持仓增至848,000枚。此外，公司提交代理文件寻求股东批准将STRC、STRF、STRK和STRD的股息支付改为每个工作日支付，特别股东大会定于10月28日。Q3比特币持仓仅净增1,666枚，因当季买入7,218枚并卖出5,553枚；Q3回购STRC支出约13.8亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: During the week of Sept 29–Oct 5, Strategy bought 334 BTC for $28.7 million while repurchasing about 1.77 million STRC shares for $176.3 million; BTC holdings reached 848,000. It also filed a proxy seeking shareholder approval to move STRC, STRF, STRK and STRD to daily dividend payments, with a special meeting set for Oct. 28. Q3 BTC holdings rose only 1,666 BTC net as it bought 7,218 and sold 5,553; Q3 STRC repurchases totaled about $1.38 billion.
updates.current_state_zh: Strategy持续将资本配置优先用于STRC回购而非增持比特币：截至2026年10月5日当周，其买入334枚BTC（2870万美元），并回购约177万股STRC（1.763亿美元），比特币持仓达848,000枚。Q3比特币净增仅1,666枚，同期STRC回购支出约13.8亿美元。公司正寻求股东批准将STRC、STRF、STRK和STRD的股息改为每日支付，投票定于10月28日；STRC交易价约99.45美元，仍低于100美元目标价。
updates.current_state_en: Strategy continues to prioritize STRC buybacks over Bitcoin accumulation: in the week ended Oct. 5, 2026, it bought 334 BTC for $28.7 million while repurchasing about 1.77 million STRC shares for $176.3 million, bringing BTC holdings to 848,000. Q3 net BTC increase was only 1,666 BTC, while STRC repurchases totaled about $1.38 billion. It is seeking shareholder approval to move STRC, STRF, STRK and STRD to daily dividend payments, with a vote on Oct. 28; STRC trades near $99.45, still below its $100 target.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Strategy bought 334 BTC for $28.7 million last week while spending $176.3 million to repurchase about 1.77 million STRC preferred shares and seeking shareholder approval to overhaul preferred-stock dividend payments.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Strategy bought 334 BTC for $28.7 million last week while spending $176.3 million to repurchase about 1.77 million STRC preferred shares and seeking shareholder approval to overhaul preferred-stock dividend payments.
updates.background_zh: Strategy（原 MicroStrategy）是最大的企业比特币持有者，通过股票、可转换债券和优先证券为其储备策略融资。STRC 是其可变利率 A 系列永久拉伸优先股（Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock），是公司配合普通股发行所使用的多类优先股之一。8-K 表格是 SEC 要求用于及时披露重大公司事件的当前报告。
updates.background_en: Strategy, formerly MicroStrategy, is the largest corporate holder of Bitcoin and funds its treasury strategy through equity, convertible debt and preferred securities. STRC is its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock, one of several preferred classes the company has used alongside common-stock issuance. Form 8-K is the SEC current report used to disclose material corporate events promptly.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该披露将关注点转向最大的企业比特币储备如何为自身融资：大规模 STRC 回购和拟议的每日派息安排，直接影响 Strategy 优先证券的流动性与价格稳定性，并间接影响市场对企业储备式比特币需求的情绪。MSTR 与 STRC 是直接受影响的上市工具，其影响可能外溢至更广泛的企业比特币持有者板块，而非比特币现货市场结构本身。
updates.market_impact_en: The disclosure shifts attention to how the largest corporate Bitcoin treasury funds itself: heavy STRC buybacks and a proposed daily dividend schedule bear on the liquidity and price stability of Strategy's preferred securities and, indirectly, on sentiment toward corporate-treasury Bitcoin demand. MSTR and STRC are the directly affected listed instruments, with knock-on effects possible for the broader corporate-Bitcoin-holder segment rather than for Bitcoin's spot market structure.

updates.title_zh: Strategy的美元现金七周内下降60%
updates.title_en: Strategy’s USD Cash down 60% in seven weeks
updates.what_changed_zh: 截至2026年10月11日，Strategy的USD Cash从8月30日的16.1亿美元降至6.405亿美元，降幅60%；20亿美元STRC回购授权仅剩3.548亿美元；独立USD Reserve同期从51.0亿美元降至48.8亿美元。按近七周约9.7亿美元的消耗速度，若不补充，USD Cash约四周内耗尽。
updates.what_changed_en: As of Oct 11, 2026, Strategy's USD Cash fell 60% from $1.61B on Aug 30 to $640.5M; only $354.8M of its $2B STRC buyback authorization remained; the separate USD Reserve declined from $5.10B to $4.88B. At the ~$970M burn pace over less than seven weeks, USD Cash could run out in about four weeks absent replenishment.
updates.current_state_zh: Strategy继续将资本配置优先用于STRC回购以维持其接近100美元的目标价：截至2026年10月11日，USD Cash降至6.405亿美元（8月30日为16.1亿美元），20亿美元STRC回购授权仅剩3.548亿美元，USD Reserve降至48.8亿美元。比特币持仓为848,000枚（截至10月5日）。股东10月28日将就优先股每日派息投票。按近期消耗速度，USD Cash若不补充或在约四周内耗尽。
updates.current_state_en: Strategy continues prioritizing STRC buybacks to defend its ~$100 target price: as of Oct 11, 2026, USD Cash fell to $640.5M (from $1.61B on Aug 30), only $354.8M of its $2B STRC buyback authorization remained, and the USD Reserve declined to $4.88B. BTC holdings were 848,000 as of Oct 5. Shareholders vote Oct 28 on daily preferred dividends. At the recent burn rate, USD Cash could be depleted in about four weeks without replenishment.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Strategy's USD cash reserves dropped 60% in seven weeks — from $1.61B to $640.5M — as the company spent heavily buying back its STRC preferred stock to defend its ~$100 target price, funded largely by earlier common-shareholder dilution.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Strategy's USD cash reserves dropped 60% in seven weeks — from $1.61B to $640.5M — as the company spent heavily buying back its STRC preferred stock to defend its ~$100 target price, funded largely by earlier common-shareholder dilution.
updates.background_zh: Strategy 于 8 月 24 日设立了“美元现金”这一资金池，其大部分资金来自前一周出售约 20 亿美元 MSTR 股票所得的约 15.7 亿美元。公司当时表示，美元现金“与美元储备形成互补，为管理层提供更灵活的流动性来源”。较早设立的美元储备有更严格的使用限制，除董事会正式另行授权外，只能用于支付优先股股息和利息；例如在 10 月 4 日当周，Strategy 为此支付了 1.425 亿美元。
updates.background_en: Strategy created the USD Cash bucket on August 24, funding most of it with about $1.57 billion from the sale of roughly $2 billion of MSTR stock the prior week. The company said at the time that USD Cash “complements the USD Reserve by providing management with a more flexible source of liquidity.” The older USD Reserve carries stricter limits and may be used for preferred dividends and interest payments unless the board formally authorizes otherwise; Strategy paid out $142.5 million for those purposes during the week of October 4.
updates.market_impact_zh: Strategy 是最大的企业级比特币持有者，因此其美元缓冲变薄会通过“储备增持能力”这一渠道影响市场上来自企业金库的边际买盘，而非通过协议或供给层面的变化。同时，STRC 回购的成本直接落在优先股持有人与 MSTR 普通股股东身上，因为所用现金主要来自普通股增发稀释。
updates.market_impact_en: Strategy is the largest corporate holder of bitcoin, so a thinner dollar cushion affects the marginal corporate bid for BTC through treasury-accumulation capacity rather than through protocol or supply changes. The STRC buybacks also put preferred holders and MSTR common shareholders directly on the hook for the capital-structure cost, since the cash used was largely raised via common-share dilution.
